versions.subject: New Rule - Linux - Auditd - Screen Capture with xwd
versions.detection:
xwd:
    type: EXECVE
    a0: xwd
xwd_root_window:
    a1: '-root'
    a2: '-out'
    a3|endswith: '.xwd'
xwd_no_root_window:
    a1: '-out'
    a2|endswith: '.xwd'
condition: xwd and (xwd_root_window or xwd_no_root_window)
versions.spl: type="EXECVE" a0="xwd" (a1="-root" a2="-out" a3="*.xwd") OR (a1="-out" a2="*.xwd")
